integrationPolicy.foundationMeaning: Shared foundational capabilities come first. The combined path is not the union of all advanced Data, SDE, Quant and AI courses.
foundationGate: Basic Python execution, functions, loops and debugging.
Arithmetic, algebra, elementary functions and graph reading.
Basic descriptive statistics and probability vocabulary.
Clear technical reading, note taking and evidence-based problem solving.
integrationPolicy.crossTrackPrerequisitePolicy: No undefined foundation-module IDs are embedded. The implementation should connect its canonical Foundation capability checks through canonicalConceptTags.
integrationPolicy.paperFiltering: Keep lessons whose paperTags intersect the learner's selected papers. Module completion means completing only that module's eligible lessons.
integrationPolicy.sharedProgress: The 17 CS/DA-shared lessons have one canonical lesson ID and one progress record. Selecting both papers must not duplicate them.
integrationPolicy.conceptDeduplication: Reuse verified Foundation concept progress where objectives genuinely match. A matching concept tag alone must not automatically complete a more demanding GATE lesson.
integrationPolicy.initialProgress: Not started. Do not infer completion from the learner's degree or employment.
integrationPolicy.moduleOrder: Follow the listed order, respecting prerequisites. Independent modules may run in parallel.
integrationPolicy.lessonDelivery: These are substantial revision units, not counts of individual videos. Break units longer than 180 minutes into 60-90 minute study blocks.
integrationPolicy.timeEstimateMeaning: Estimates include selected lectures, targeted reading and the original assignment for an experienced CSE graduate. They do not represent the length of every linked course.
integrationPolicy.additionalPracticeRecommendation: After these units, reserve a separate, adjustable block of approximately 100-180 hours for spaced revision, official-paper practice and weak-topic repair. This is a planning recommendation, not an exam requirement.
careerConnections: Algorithms and systems support the later SDE stream.
Relational modeling and warehousing support the Data stream.
Probability, linear algebra and optimization support Quant and AI study.
Machine learning and probabilistic reasoning support the AI stream without replacing its advanced engineering curriculum.

assessmentPolicy.provenance: All 29 embedded questions and all assignment instructions are original preparation material, not actual GATE questions.
assessmentPolicy.choiceAnswerEncoding: Choice strings carry A/B/C/D labels. MCQ answers are one label; MSQ answers are arrays of labels.

assessmentPolicy.reviewCadence: Attempt recall without notes immediately after learning, then approximately 2, 7 and 21 days later.
assessmentPolicy.masteryRule: Retain reasoning and error corrections, not only a final score. Reattempt missed questions after a delay.
assessmentPolicy.thirdPartyPractice: Link to official papers and legitimate practice sites. Do not reproduce their question statements, solution manuals or platform solutions.

questions.prompt: What is the nullity of the 3-by-3 matrix with rows (1,2,3), (2,4,6) and (0,1,1)?

questions.prompt: Project (3,1) orthogonally onto the span of (1,1). What is the squared Euclidean norm of the residual?
